mode.description: Filtering mode: 'block' (default), 'monitor', or 'off'. In 'monitor' mode, violations are logged but not blocked.

proxy.description: Upstream proxy used to reach the content filtering service.

api.description: API endpoint and authentication for remote filtering service.

url.description: Base URL of the filtering API.

key.description: API key for authentication (leave blank if using token file or none).

block_categories.description: List of category IDs to block (e.g., 'malware', 'phishing').

exception_domains.description: List of full domain names exempt from filtering (e.g., 'internal.example.org').

exception_hosts.description: List of hostnames (not full FQDNs) exempt from filtering (e.g., 'gateway').

exception_urls.description: List of URLs to whitelist, optionally with comments.

comment.description: Optional note explaining why this URL is whitelisted.

rate_limiting.description: Optional rate limiting per client IP.

enabled.description: Enable per-client rate limiting for API requests.

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum requests per minute per client IP.

burst_size.description: Maximum burst (extra requests allowed before throttling).
